quote: They handed over on the date they gave us in the very first meeting. In eleven years of building hotels, that had not happened to me before.
name: Rhea Sabharwal

quote: Fit-out and AV came from one group, so nobody could pass the blame around. Our snag list closed in nine days.
name: Vikram Nair

quote: The team treated a 900 sq ft flat with the same seriousness as the penthouse next door. That is the reason we recommend them.
name: Anita Deshpande

quote: Drawings were excellent and the joinery is beautiful. The stone supplier ran three weeks late, though the team kept us informed the whole way.
name: Karan Bhatia

quote: Two floors of a working office, refitted over weekends without losing a single business day. Planning was the whole job.
name: Sunita Menon

quote: Six months after handover I asked for a small change to a wardrobe. Someone came the same week and did not invoice us.
name: Aditya Kulkarni

quote: Good quality throughout and a very professional site team. I would have liked one more round of material samples early on.
name: Neha Shroff

quote: They rebuilt our clinic reception around live patient traffic. Clean, quiet and dust-sealed every single evening.
name: Dr. Imran Shaikh

quote: Our villa took fourteen months and I never once had to chase for a status update. The weekly report was genuinely honest about delays.
name: Priya Raghavan

quote: The restaurant opened on schedule and the acoustics are the thing guests mention most. That was their suggestion, not ours.
name: Joel D'Souza

quote: Strong detailing and a tidy site. Costs moved slightly during the project, but every change was explained before it was spent.
name: Ramesh Patel

quote: We have now done three offices with them. The reason is simple: the same project manager turns up each time and remembers everything.
name: Lakshmi Venkatesh
